source: create a open world car game for me with city and cars and ai people and cars thank you so muchhh

image_prompt.text: Wide, flat, grid-aligned city streets sized for cars to turn without clipping - the connective tissue of the whole map
A large open common area of the city that the whole server draws on rather than any one player
City blocks of buildings - shops, offices and homes - lining the streets and giving the driving somewhere to be

layout_placement.text: Origins for AI traffic feeding onto the road network
Origins for AI pedestrians on the sidewalks
Where drivable cars appear for players to take

notes: Classified Simulation rather than Racing on the genre file's own boundary rule: there is no lap or finish condition here, players just operate vehicles in a persistent world.

Preset caveat: Vehicle Sim's shared resource field is modelled on hauling and extraction. The prompt gives it nothing to be, so it was kept as an open common area rather than dropped, but it is unsupported by anything the user said.
The city itself - buildings, blocks, intersections - has no option in this genre. Only the roads do.
AI pedestrians and AI traffic are the bulk of what was asked for and no option in the file covers ambient population.

open_questions.ask: Modern Urban was inferred from the word 'city' - should it be present-day, retro, or futuristic?
How big is 'open world' here - a few city blocks or a sprawling region?
Is there anything to do besides drive - jobs, races, police chases - or is it pure free roam?

coverage_missing.ask: What era and mood should the city be?
How large should the city be?
Is there any objective, or is it free roam?
Do players go inside any buildings, or is it all street level?

answers.ask: Modern Urban was inferred from the word 'city' - should it be present-day, retro, or futuristic?
answers.answer: Make it a present-day modern urban city.

answers.ask: How big is 'open world' here - a few city blocks or a sprawling region?
answers.answer: Use a few city blocks so it is a focused, playable open-world city.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides drive - jobs, races, police chases - or is it pure free roam?
answers.answer: Keep it pure free roam: players can drive around the city alongside AI people and cars.
